findings.input: authenticated user A receives a protected deep link, then user B becomes current before validation resolves
findings.mission: avoid executing user A navigation under user B
findings.expected: pending protected intent is bound to the authenticated user and discarded on mismatch
findings.actual: the pending intent previously carried route scope but no authenticated-user binding
findings.rootCause: navigation validation and session identity were tracked separately
findings.fix: bind authenticated pending intents to userId, clear on logout, recheck membership after hydration, and ignore stale validation tokens

findings.actor: owner or co-parent adding a preparation comment
findings.input: response loss followed by retry with the same logical comment
findings.mission: create one activity and one recipient notification
findings.expected: comment, notifications and outbox are atomic and idempotent
findings.actual: comment creation lacked a client mutation key and was not connected to recipient notifications/outbox
findings.rootCause: collaboration activity and delivery pipeline were separate operations
findings.fix: add stable clientMutationId/Idempotency-Key and create activity, delivery and outbox rows in one transaction

findings.actor: owner with replacement or recurring due item
findings.input: two schedulers on the same KST due window and an interval changed after scheduling
findings.mission: receive one current notification and no stale notification
findings.expected: one logical due key, deterministic one-winner effect and worker-time revalidation
findings.actual: the data fields existed but no shared KST due evaluator and idempotent worker pipeline connected them
findings.rootCause: temporal fields were persisted without a caller-clock domain contract and due-event scheduler
findings.fix: add explicit-clock KST evaluation, deterministic due keys, transactional enqueue and membership/plan/due revalidation

findings.input: filter, paginate and mutate one user-report queue row
findings.mission: preserve queue state and update only the affected queue
findings.expected: one mutation, one scoped refetch and no full catalog reload
findings.actual: queue state was shared and development StrictMode could duplicate initial queue fetches; mutations reloaded broad catalog data
findings.rootCause: queue presentation and refresh logic shared page-global state
findings.fix: store per-queue filter/page state, single-flight initial load and queue-only refresh
findings.residualRisk: external operator session is not qualified

findings.actor: API client replaying a successful create
findings.input: same Idempotency-Key after a lost 201 response
findings.mission: receive a contract-compatible replay without a duplicate side effect
findings.expected: replay retains the original HTTP status and body
findings.actual: the interceptor forced a 200 status for stored responses
findings.rootCause: stored response replay omitted the original response status
findings.fix: restore the stored original status before returning the replayed body

findings.input: static inspection of the one Release 4H internal APK
findings.mission: keep Android permissions minimal and distinguish source remediation from artifact proof
findings.actual: the merged APK contained READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE and WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE from a transitive library manifest
findings.rootCause: removing declarations from the app manifest does not remove transitive manifest declarations
findings.fix: add explicit manifest-merger tools:node=remove declarations and a source contract test
findings.residualRisk: the built APK is pre-fix and must not be installed or presented as current-source evidence

findings.expected: orchestrator replaces or restarts the worker and the lease is reclaimed
findings.actual: docker kill left the service exited until an explicit docker start
findings.rootCause: manual stop/kill semantics did not exercise automatic service replacement in the local compose invocation
findings.fix: no source change; explicit restart recovered and the DB lease-reclaim contract passed
findings.residualRisk: external orchestrator restart/replacement policy remains unqualified
